notes.title: Tutorial Patch: Enhanced Tutorials & Reduced Glitches
notes.notes:
[h1]The Cooking Game VR: Patch Update - Enhancing Your Culinary Journey! 🍕🍷
[/h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32881072/68093ca37bcba7b925da9b261cfcb37b0a675c71.jpg[/img]
Hello, Chefs! 👩‍🍳👨‍🍳
We’re thrilled to bring you a fresh patch update for The Cooking Game VR, addressing some of the key issues you've encountered. Our team has been hard at work to ensure your virtual kitchen experience is as smooth and enjoyable as possible. Here's what's cooking in this update:

[h3]1. Enhanced Tutorials & Reduced Glitches
[/h3]
 
[u][b]Expanded Tutorial Access: [/b][/u]
We've listened to your feedback and have made tutorials available on all home screens. Now, you can easily access guidance whenever you need it, ensuring you're never left guessing in the kitchen.
    
[u][b]Italian Food Level Fixes:[/b][/u]
Wine Stability: We've fixed the issue where wine wouldn't stay on the tray. You can now serve with confidence!

[u][b]Adjustable Counters: [/b][/u]
To enhance comfort, counters will now adjust up and down according to your preference.

[u][b]General Glitch Reduction: [/b][/u]
Numerous glitches have been addressed across various levels to provide a smoother gameplay experience.

[h3]2. Tutorial Improvements
[/h3]
[b][u]Seamless Progression: [/u][/b]
We've resolved the issue where players were unable to progress past pouring pizza sauce. Now, each step guides you smoothly through creating the perfect pizza.
    
[b][u]Ingredient Guidance: [/u][/b]
No more trial and error! The tutorial now clearly indicates when all ingredients are correctly placed on your pizza masterpiece.

[b][u]Tutorial Navigation: [/u][/b]
Accidentally skipped a tutorial? No worries! You can now easily return to any part of the tutorial without losing progress or starting over.

Thank you for your patience and support as we continue to improve The Cooking Game VR. We hope these updates make your culinary adventures even more delightful and immersive!
Happy Cooking! 🥳

notes.title: Game Update: A Taste of Japan Awaits! 🍣🍜
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32881072/e76d4ed1e1f1b742b2cde06120cc1a667ef63752.jpg[/img]Dear Culinary Adventurers,

We are thrilled to announce an exciting new addition to "The Cooking Game VR" that will transport your taste buds straight to the heart of Japan! 🌸

[h1]New Sushi Restaurant 🇯🇵 Is Here [/h1]
Step into a world where tradition meets innovation, and immerse yourself in the art of Japanese cuisine. Our latest update brings you:

[b][u]Authentic Recipes:[/u][/b]
 Master the delicate art of sushi rolling, perfect your ramen broth, and explore a variety of traditional dishes that capture the essence of Japanese culinary artistry. 🍣🍜🥢

[b][u]Cultural Ambiance[/u][/b]
Experience the serene beauty and vibrant energy of a Japanese restaurant setting, complete with intricate decor and soothing sounds that make every cooking session feel like a journey through Japan.

[b][u]New Challenges[/u][/b]
Hone your skills as you tackle unique challenges designed to test your speed, precision, and creativity in crafting exquisite Japanese meals.

Join us in this flavorful adventure and elevate your virtual cooking experience with our newest update. Don your chef's hat, embrace the spirit of Japan, and let’s create culinary magic together!

Happy Cooking!
Enjoy bringing this new flavor to life!

notes.title: The Ultimate Culinary Conquest: The Cooking Game VR Unleashes Version 2!
notes.notes:
Dear Chefs and Gastronomy Enthusiasts!

Today marks a monumental day in the history of virtual reality cooking simulations. After six years of simmering in Early Access, we are thrilled to announce that "The Cooking Game VR" has fully matured into its most delectable form yet with the launch of Version 2!

[h2] What's Cooking in Version 2? [/h2]

We've taken your feedback and turned up the heat on development to serve you a feast of features:

[h3]Double the Delight[/h3] 🍕🍔
Not one, but [b]TWO[/b] distinct themed restaurants for double the culinary challenges. 
Dive into the fast-paced frenzy of a fast food joint and the rustic charm of an Italian 🤌 pizzeria.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32881072/74fb0790750e027c19c0ae9e33bddfa5fc45aef7.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32881072/74fb0790750e027c19c0ae9e33bddfa5fc45aef7.gif[/img][/url]

[h3]Vast Menu Variety[/h3]
Expand your palate with an extended menu including
 fizzy sodas, orange juice, rich risottos, and exotic wines, alongside the classic burgers, hotdogs, and fries.
🍔 🍟 🌭 🥤🧃🍕🧀🥣🍷

[h3]Serve with Style[/h3]
Innovate with your service as you slide trays to waitresses down slopes in the vibrant pizza restaurant environment.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32881072/6b9277ee479be1c910af85f8d276dae982095763.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32881072/6b9277ee479be1c910af85f8d276dae982095763.gif[/img][/url]

[h3]Kitchen Calamities [/h3]
Keep the pressure under control as you face kitchen fires, pesky pests, and even mischievous pigeons intent on snatching your gourmet creations.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32881072/0d073ceec8cbc5c8cc679ed2c9c04b4ed2a457ac.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32881072/0d073ceec8cbc5c8cc679ed2c9c04b4ed2a457ac.gif[/img][/url]

[h3]Tools of the Trade[/h3] 
Earn coins to unlock a treasure trove of kitchen items to enhance your culinary arsenal and improve your efficiency.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32881072/d2f95c8ce3041f7ddb7bc5f303179964438b960c.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32881072/d2f95c8ce3041f7ddb7bc5f303179964438b960c.gif[/img][/url]

 [h2]Multiplayer Mayhem & Cross-Platform Play[/h2] 🕹️🏆

The multiplayer experience is now hotter than ever:

[h3]Cross-Platform PvP[/h3]
Steam VR and Oculus users can now slice and dice in head-to-head competition, thanks to our cross-platform update!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32881072/e9e33cc1760879a196962e2600e970668b74da38.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32881072/e9e33cc1760879a196962e2600e970668b74da38.gif[/img][/url]

[h3]Global Leaderboards[/h3] 
Compete with chefs worldwide and climb the ranks to prove who's the ultimate kitchen commander.

[h3]Duel Delights[/h3]
Challenge online players to a PvP match and show off your swift serving skills and strategic kitchen management.

 [h2]From Early Access to Full Launch[/h2] 🚀

This transformation from Early Access to Full Launch means that "The Cooking Game VR" has been refined, optimized, and loaded with content thanks to your invaluable input and support.

We are proud to serve you a game that has been cooked to perfection, and we invite you to tie on your aprons, sharpen your kitchen skills, and dive into the richest, most expansive culinary experience in virtual reality.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32881072/06adaef5bff165173bd5d25796f18ea2e0a4313b.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32881072/06adaef5bff165173bd5d25796f18ea2e0a4313b.gif[/img][/url]

Engage in the heat of competition, rise through the ranks in our global leaderboards, and become a legendary chef in a world that celebrates the art of cooking. 

So, grab your spatula and chef's hat – it's time to embark on an unforgettable gastronomic journey that only gets better with every bite. 

Welcome to the Grand Opening of "The Cooking Game VR" – where your virtual kitchen dreams become a delightful reality!

notes.title: Hell's Kitchen Update is now available in "public" channel
notes.notes:
We have moved Hell's Kitchen update to "public" channel.

Here's what the update contains:
– Food items left too long in the cooking pans will cause kitchen fire
– Waitress will leave the kitchen area when kitchen fire occurs
– New item – “Fire extinguisher” is provided to put out the kitchen fire
– Fridge doors now auto close when opened {with a bit of “Surprise”}
– Empty plates are now breakable if slammed or thrown
– New item – “Brush” is provided to clean up the kitchen mess
– Waitress and customers will react if you throw items towards them (NOT advisable – parental supervision is advised + It’s RUDE to do so)


Feel free to leave your feedback/comment in the discussion board.
Thanks!

notes.title: Hell’s Kitchen update is now available!
notes.notes:
Hello guys,
After weeks of testing, troubleshooting, polishing etc, Hell’s Kitchen update is now made available for everyone on Steam Beta Branch.

Here is a list of updates we added:
– Food items left too long in the cooking pans will cause kitchen fire
– Waitress will leave the kitchen area when kitchen fire occurs
– New item – “Fire extinguisher” is provided to put out the kitchen fire
– Fridge doors now auto close when opened {with a bit of “Surprise”}
– Empty plates are now breakable if slammed or thrown
– New item – “Brush” is provided to clean up the kitchen mess
– Waitress and customers will react if you throw items towards them ([b]NOT advisable – parental supervision is advised [/b] + It’s RUDE to do so)

To access the new features, follow this guide on how to activate the beta branch:
1. Right click ‘The Cooking Game VR’ and open Properties
https://prnt.sc/kwagb1

2. Click on ‘beta test’ in the dropdown list
https://prnt.sc/kwagup

3. Enter this access code "betaplayspirit" to unlock it.

4. Wait for the new update to finish download

Enjoy!

Let's COOOOOOK!ːsteamhappyː

This build should be bug-free from our countless hours of testing.
However if you discover something new, feel free to share it on the discussion thread.

For more information about LIV Mixed Reality Set up, please visit:
https://liv.tv
https://wiki.liv.tv/index.php/Main_Page
